License: MIT, retained in LICENSE, plus component license files under ggml/vendor.

Vendored unmodified subset: CMakeLists.txt, LICENSE, cmake/, include/, src/,
ggml/, vendor/. Standalone tools, servers, examples, model files, and Python
packages are omitted. App CMake disables common, tools, examples, server, app,
OpenSSL, subprocesses, dynamic backends and all GPU backends. CPU inference only.
The app's JNI bridge is outside this directory, in app/src/main/cpp/.
